newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside soars on NW Shelf expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside soars on NW Shelf expansion.

text.p: The shares of Woodside Petroleum Ltd rose sharply on Friday after the company said on Thursday partners in the the North-West Shelf liquified natural gas project had agreed to a A$6.0 billion expansion.
At 10.40 a.m. (0040 GMT), Woodside shares were 15 cents firmer at A$9.00 on turnover of 241,194 shares. The stock earlier touched a life-time high of A$9.10.
Woodside said on Thursday the A$6 billion expansion would add about seven million tonnes per annum to the existing sales capacity of about 7.5 million tonnes per annum.
"Investors have read the papers this morning and concluded the stock is a good buy at these levels," a Sydney-based dealer said.

Woodside is an equal 16.66 percent shareholder in the project along with BHP Petroleum (North West Shelf) Pty Ltd, BP Developments Australia Ltd, Chevron Asiatic Ltd, Shell Development (Australia) Pty Ltd, and Japan Australia LNG (MIMI) Pty Ltd.
The shares of BHP, whose fortunes are not so closely linked to the gas project, were up 21 cents at A$17.48 at 11.00 a.m. (0100 GMT) in a firmer market.
